_note: @fluentui/svg-icons' icons/ holds <name>_<size>_<style>.svg for sizes 10-48 and four styles. The pack keeps size 24, regular and filled, as regular/<slug> and filled/<slug>: split-variants names only the _24_regular and _24_filled suffixes, so every other file is dropped. The npm package ships no licence file (licence_missing); licenses/fluentui-system-icons/ needs a source.md before the first real sync, or the sink removes the hand-supplied texts. Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 4,992 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
